theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (ν' : Measure (Euclid P)) (τ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (ζ₀ : MultiVector P n) (s B R : ℝ) (G : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν' K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable τ ν' → 0 ≤ s → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ζ₀ α| ≤ s * covectorEuclideanNorm α) → 0 ≤ B → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ‖α‖ ≤ B * covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, X ω = ∫ x, τ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂ν') → IsOpen G → G ⊆ closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R → X.massOn G ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s * ν' G + ENNReal.ofReal B * ∫⁻ x in closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R, ‖τ x - ζ₀‖ₑ ∂ν'
